name: ST2 concussion missile tube
description: The ST2 concussion missile tube was a concussion missile launcher manufactured by Arakyd Industries. The launcher had a magazine of four concussion missiles, typically Arakyd's ST2 concussion missile. The price of 1,500 credits made it popular with independent starship owners. The YT-1300 light freighter Millennium Falcon was equipped with a pair of ST2 concussion missile racks located between the forward mandibles.
